annotations.title: Signed evidence bundle: receipt, listing match and seller facts

description: Turn a settled x402 payment into a signed bundle: the on-chain receipt with canonical text and SHA-256, the price the same host and path advertise on the Coinbase Bazaar and whether it matched, plus explicit limits. Signed with our Ed25519 key and issued in our name, whoever the seller is. It does NOT prove what was delivered. Failed lookups return partial evidence with errors. Use before approving a payment or closing an agent's books. Example: hash=0x778c8c1b1fd1b320bf045eae0af7274e74a9e2e1f83c34ec96d9f825aea3b933. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb, op or polygon

hash.description: Transaction hash of the payment (0x, 64 hex characters)

payTo.description: Optional: the payee, when the transaction holds several USDC transfers

resource.description: Optional: the URL the payment bought, checked against the catalog price
